works.body:
knD-san, hello! Sorry to bother you! Apologies again for using a translator—our previous collaboration was fantastic! I saw the incredibly cool full-body illustrations you drew earlier and absolutely loved them. Would it be possible to commission you to create a new full-body illustration featuring the two original characters you drew before? 🤲💖
Regarding the content: I'd love to see them standing together, striking bold and dynamic combat poses (if weapons appear, they'd be firearms), or any other form of interaction! Feel free to interpret this however you're most comfortable! *If you're currently not taking on this type of work, or if the commission feels challenging, please feel free to decline! If the amount offered isn't sufficient, don't hesitate to suggest a more appropriate fee~
I'm really eager to see your interpretation of these characters! Please let your creativity run wild! If possible, I'd appreciate it if you could consider this request! https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lnbe1lfhGiI-hiYMEGDzt1DiX10uF2wj
